audience: Editors who already know how to write and need the export command
outcome: Reach the export reference without reading the publishing tutorial

sections.heading: Choose a task
sections.text: Open a guide or look up a command.

sections.heading: Publish a first document
sections.text: Create a document. Add a title and a paragraph. Choose a destination. Review the document before publication.

sections.heading: Export command
sections.text: Launch the export command to save a local copy. The destination path is required.
